queries_run: DexCom credit rating downgrade OR guidance cut 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：三家客戶（A/B/C，皆>10%）占營收比重分別 55%/35%/46%（2024 為 40%/35%/42%，2023 為 35%/30%/37%）；占應收帳款 24%/20%/24%。營收為扣除費用、折扣、回扣後淨額，回扣付給其他實體者排除，故合計可超過 100%。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 附註 Concentration of Credit Risk and Significant Customers
findings.excerpt: Customer A 55 % 40 % 35 % 24 % 18 % Customer B 35 % 35 % 30 % 20 % 21 % Customer C 46 % 42 % 37 % 24 % 27 % * Total revenue for each customer is net of fees, cash discounts, and rebates directly allocable to that customer. Rebates paid to other entities are excluded; therefore, the combined value may exceed 100%.

findings.claim: 公司稱以歷史趨勢、客戶財務狀況與外部市場因素監控客戶信用。
findings.excerpt: We monitor the creditworthiness of our customers based on historical trends, the financial condition of our customers, and external market factors.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 搜尋 2026 年未見 DexCom 信用評等被調降報導；搜尋摘要僅指向 2026 Q2 10-Q（distributor 約占營收八成多，為搜尋工具自行算術，未核原文）。未查到客戶端（經銷商）破產/降評證據。

clues.claim: 2026 Q2 10-Q 顯示經銷商管道為主要營收來源（Q2 經銷商約 $1,102.4M vs 直銷 $206M）
